rationale: Most important function knob of a 1x4 MMI: mmi_length_um (the self-imaging length). width_um = 19.462 = mmi_width_um, because the guide this knob lengthens IS the multimode body (a 19.462-um-wide waveguide); the expected area response is mmi_width_um * delta. The single-mode wire width (1.25 um) would be the right width_um only for a knob that stretches the wires, which this one does not. delta_length_um in lengths.json is the MMI body length measured from the script's own gf.Path objects (arms = propagation planes bounding the multimode body).
